adapter.target_modules: language model q/k/v/o and gate/up/down projections

thinking: off (enable_thinking=false) for rollouts, training and evaluation
reward: share of the matter's rubric criteria met, judged by Claude Sonnet 5.5 over the full rubric; 0 if a quotation is found in no matter file
advantage: group-normalised within a matter's 4 rollouts: (r - mean) / (std + 1e-6); groups with zero spread are skipped
loss: -advantage x mean log-probability of the completion tokens
updates_per_round: one on-policy pass over the round's rollouts (8 optimizer steps)

evaluation.set: 11 Harvey LAB intellectual-property tasks, not used in training
evaluation.judge: Claude Opus 5.5, full rubric, one call per deliverable

hardware: 1x H100 80GB on Modal; vLLM 0.31.0 for rollouts and evaluation, transformers 5.17 + peft 0.21 for updates
